verdict.rationale: Segment Functions let you write JavaScript to build custom sources and destinations with no extra infrastructure, so custom code can shape data on the way in or out. The schema enforcement claim hints at some quality filtering. But nothing in the evidence documents in-pipeline transformation, filtering, or enrichment of events before they reach existing destinations; Functions are described only as custom sources and destinations. missing for 10: documented in-pipeline transform/filter capability (e.g. functions running before destinations), enrichment features, filtering rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
